headlines.text: Flash back to 2020, when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW World Tag Team Titles as The Young Bucks vs. FTR battled it out, appearing on Full Gear, rated 9.07 ? an incredible outing ? ending the champion's reign at 4 defenses.
